The '''Science Office''' was a scientific division of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that advised on major scientific matters. After the [[Conquest of Makeb]] ended with the mysterious survival of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], the Science Office was called in to determine how the planet had survived.
